metadata.status: Exploratory, chosen after registered outcomes were known; no causal interpretation
metadata.alignment: Unique pid arrays checked; exact set equality for correlations, deep target subset lookup into source; labels asserted equal for same-label comparisons; frozen source folds asserted equal after deep alignment. Labels from saved y, no raw hidden states loaded.
metadata.auroc: Unweighted mean of identifiable frozen fold AUROCs; conditional stratified subgroup AUROCs pooled within subgroup.
metadata.bootstrap: 2000 paired item resamples within frozen folds; any undefined draw invalidates whole interval
metadata.stratified_deviation: Explicit deviation from registered rule: resample within fold × joint(source label,target label) classes
metadata.deep_difference: target minus source, same deep items at both budgets; no native deep-budget fits
metadata.privileged: Conditioning on the other model correctness is privileged and descriptive only
